bagPolicy.summary: AT&T Stadium has implemented a bag policy to enhance public safety by restricting the size and style of bags allowed. Only clear totes, small clutch purses, and clear plastic storage bags are permitted.
allowed: Clear Tote – Plastic, vinyl or PVC and do not exceed 12″x6″x12″
Plastic Storage Bag – Clear, one(1) gallon, re-sealable
Small Clutch Purse – Approximately the size of a hand, no larger than 4.5″ x 6.5″
prohibited: All purses, bags or containers larger than a small clutch bag
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection at a designated gate.

parking.note: AT&T Stadium offers approximately 12,000 parking spaces in 15 numbered lots, with additional spaces available in lettered lots around the Texas Rangers Ballpark. Parking areas open five hours before Cowboys games, and accessible parking is available on a first come, first served basis.

rideshare.note: Taxis are also staged at this location for drop off pre-event and pick up post-event. Taxis are staged at this location for drop off pre-event and pick-up post event.

concessions.note: AT&T Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, with a focus on responsible alcohol consumption. There is a two beer limit per transaction at concession stands, and alcohol sales end at the third quarter. The venue is committed to providing an exceptional experience for all guests.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Sensory Rooms are located within the South Main Club, behind Section 416, and behind Section 446, while the additional decompression spaces are located within the North Main Club. reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in AT&T Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at AT&T Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at AT&T Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
